description: Render an animated SVG (from file path or raw SVG code) into a high-quality video (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV) or animated image (aPNG, GIF) with optional background transparency.

bgColor.description: Background color hex code (e.g. #ffffff). Cannot be used with transparent.

duration.description: Desired animation duration in seconds. If omitted, duration is auto-detected.

format.description: Output media format. Defaults to webm if transparent is true, otherwise mp4.

hold.description: Seconds to freeze the last frame at the end of the video.

outDir.description: Output directory for the generated media file. Defaults to current working directory.

scale.description: Scale factor (1-4) when using original resolution. Default: 1.

svgContent.description: Raw SVG string content to render (if svgFilePath is not provided).

svgFilePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the input .svg file.

transparent.description: Render with full alpha-channel transparency (supported for webm, gif, apng, mov).

name: render_svg_to_video
